metadata.name: Branch onboarding
metadata.description: A branch library joining: the branch says who it is, picks the integrations it needs, and runs the setup of each one it picked, in the order the response lists them, each as a durable child execution of its own. The pick is a multi-select whose values are the setups' document ids; a core.foreach walks the response and a core.subchart names its child from the loop's item (chart_from), so which children run is data. The subchart declares every outcome a setup can finish with and writes what each setup finished with to last_setup. The branch's own steps are myapp.step blocks, so Back works between them; Back does not cross into or out of a setup.

datamodel.description: What the branch's own steps collected, keyed by question key: the branch's name and the integrations it picked, as the setups' document ids. Each setup's own responses stay in the setup's own execution.

What the setup of the latest pass finished with, written by the subchart as each setup finishes: the setup's done data, whose outcome is its root outcome - done, or site_visit_needed when a card-reader setup's test card was not read.
